carry_over: a non-maleCNS type counts as present in our data only with a checked type-level crosswalk to maleCNS and the name in our type table
counting: an entry counts only if primary and its separate second read was done and agrees (strict P1 rule)

expectations.X1: a crosswalk male CNS <-> MANC/FANC/BANC exists
expectations.X2: 13Ba and 10Ba not MAPPED to single types
expectations.X3: FeCO subtypes identified in some connectome (any status but UNMAPPED)

follows: P1 docs/evidence/physiology-review-v1 (result unchanged; P2 restates D1/D2/D5 as a new result)
interpretation_limits: Public literature and documentation only; authenticated services out of scope.
Cross-dataset matches are the source authors inferences; recorded, not re-verified.
AI reviewer using web tools; declared queries, full log and separate strict second read as safeguards.
A mapping is an identity claim, not a physiological one.
No engine change; motor coordinates unchanged (20/42 admitted, +4 conditional).

labels.INCONCLUSIVE: invalid entries, duplicate ids, unchecked entries or incomplete log
labels.MAPPING_ONLY: < 2 targets but T1 or T2 at type level

levels.M-A: explicit match of the recorded cell to connectome type(s)/neurons by a stated method

query_tool: WebSearch (standard mode); each declared query run once as written; extra wording logged

restatements.D1: T1/T2 at type level if MAPPED or CANDIDATE_SET, with in-network counts
restatements.D2: T6 per MN type if MAPPED
restatements.D5: one target per (stimulated, recorded) pair of a counted functional-connectivity entry with a neural readout, both MAPPED

rules.R1: MAPPED: >=1 counted M-A entry carries over and all carried-over M-A sets agree
rules.R2: CANDIDATE_SET: only M-B, all carry over
rules.R4: SOURCE_ONLY: M-A/M-B exist but do not carry over

snowball: one level: references of included sources; citing papers of central sources via Europe PMC citations service
sources: public pages read-only; Europe PMC REST preferred for full text; bioRxiv/arXiv HTML; no bot-check, captcha, login or rate-limit bypass; no downloads without the user OK; no accounts or tokens (neuPrint out of scope)
stop_rule: per question: declared queries + snowball, or 25 included sources, whichever first
